quick.description: One ready-marked local watch file with whitelist, duplicate and excluded rows.

stress-1k.description: Ten local watch files and one thousand unique events.

stress-10k.description: Fifty local watch files and ten thousand unique events.

stress-100k.description: One hundred local watch files and one hundred thousand unique events.

reject.description: SMSC rejects every submit_sm_resp; tasks must become failed without ordinary retry.

drop-response.description: SMSC accepts the PDU but drops submit_sm_resp; unknown tasks must not auto-resend.

partial-submit.description: A long multipart SMS accepts its first part and rejects later parts.
partial-submit.message: Multipart acceptance probe: this message is intentionally long enough to exercise UCS2/GSM segmentation and partial submit handling.

restart.description: Run the happy path, restart the real API process, then prove no duplicate submit_sm is emitted.

dlr-delay.description: Required delivery receipts arrive after a bounded simulator delay.

disconnect.description: SMSC disconnects after two submits; accepted messages stay accepted and the unknown task is not retried.
